messageValues.message:
=You are the Sorento Small Talk and Clarification Assistant.

You ONLY handle:

casual messages (greetings, thanks, small talk), and

unclear or incomplete business requests that need clarification.

The main business assistant and MCP tools are handled by other agents.

INPUT CONTEXT:

message_type can be "clarification", "casual", "unknown", or "confirmation".

intent_hint and domain_hint may be null when the request is vague.

user_goal is a brief summary of what the user seems to want.

RULES:

Be brief, friendly, and professional.

Do NOT mention tools, workflows, or internal systems.

Do NOT ask for IDs, order numbers, or any detailed business data.

Do NOT give detailed product, promotion, stock, or order answers. Another agent will handle detailed answers.

If message_type is "clarification" OR intent_hint and domain_hint are both null, your MAIN job is to ask ONE short clarifying question so you understand what the user wants.

Only use a reply like “the system will check and respond shortly” when the user’s request is already clear (intent and domain are non‑null) and they are not asking anything else.

If the user just greets, greet back.

If the user says thanks, acknowledge politely and close the loop.

Keep responses short: 1–3 short sentences.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Return exactly one JSON object:

{
  "response": "short natural-language message"
}

Measured: 300-D059 is DELUXE HOME CENTRE under Mocha and DENHO HARDWARE under Sorento (exec 13695091), so re-resolving a picked customer by code reached a DIFFERENT company's customer and could not reach the picked customer's own other accounts. Customers re-resolve by the NAME we rendered to them, which cannot collide across companies. */ const v = String(String(x.hint ?? '').toLowerCase() === 'customer' ? (String(x.raw ?? '').trim() || String(x.canonical_code ?? '').trim()) : (String(x.canonical_code ?? '').trim() || (x.raw ?? ''))); return String(x.hint ?? '').toLowerCase() === 'product' ? v.replace(/[-\s]+/g, '') : v; }) : []; })()) }},

Text turns pass through unfiltered. tokens/allowed_entity_types share this SAME filtered array so they never diverge. */ const _filtered = _ents.filter(_mediaFilter); return _filtered.length > 0 ? _filtered.map(x => x.hint) : []; })()) }},
  "access_levels": {{ JSON.stringify($('Call \'sub-query-reformulator\'').item.json.output.access_levels || []) }},

nodes.name: dym-transform
nodes.notes: dym-probe-before-offer: pure planner. Mirrors D1 candidate selection, decides whether a has-it probe runs. Passes the not-found payload through.

nodes.name: dym-gate
nodes.notes: dym-probe-before-offer: TRUE -> run the has-it probe; FALSE -> today's un-annotated offer, byte-identical.

nodes.name: dym-probe
nodes.notes: dym-probe-before-offer: read-only has-it probe. Copy of sibling-probe; tool + entities read from dym-transform. Clone target rysSPgUssLDf6xJc (sub-get-results TEST); live-promote value would be Fss5aAaXthJSWpZCgKiKR. onError=continueRegularOutput ON PURPOSE (never continueErrorOutput).

nodes.name: dym-annotate
nodes.notes: dym-probe-before-offer: turns the probe envelope into dym_available_codes + dym_probe_meta, and re-sources the NOT-FOUND payload by name. Fails open.

nodes.name: dym-transform-partial
nodes.notes: dym-probe-before-offer, PARTIAL lane. jsCode BYTE-IDENTICAL to dym-transform.

nodes.name: dym-gate-partial
nodes.notes: dym-probe-before-offer, PARTIAL lane: TRUE -> probe; FALSE -> compile-current-state unchanged.

nodes.name: dym-probe-partial
nodes.notes: dym-probe-before-offer, PARTIAL lane: identical to dym-probe except it reads dym-transform-partial. Same read-only tools, same clone target rysSPgUssLDf6xJc, onError=continueRegularOutput.

nodes.notes: dym-probe-before-offer, PARTIAL lane. jsCode differs from dym-annotate in exactly two lane-config literals.
